snippet.title: MediAevi First Look - A Rimworld and Dwarf Fortress Inspired Colony Sim
snippet.description: A short video showing some of the gameplay and features of the game MediAevi, which is currently in development.  MediAevi is a medieval fantasy colony sim that is inspired by such games as Rimworld and Dwarf Fortress.
